prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: game prop PBR base-colour texture for the dark painted-steel steering-column casing of a worn industrial forklift in the Lowtide dockyard map. One seamless square 2048 x 2048 texture image.
Primary request: create a photographic, flat full-bleed material scan of aged very dark charcoal enamel paint over steel, replacing a blurry procedural surface. The surface must stay clearly dark charcoal, not pale grey or orange.
Materials/textures: surviving dark grey-black satin enamel with extremely fine irregular orange-peel grain, small sharp hairline abrasion scratches from workshop handling, sparse tiny chips exposing dull grey steel, a few tiny desaturated brown corrosion pits, localized faint dusty smudges and dry greasy finger marks. About 94 percent intact paint. Crisp restrained physical wear at realistic small scale; no broad cloudy camouflage-like blobs. Quiet, even overall material that can wrap around an angular steel casing. No special border wear because the model supplies the edges.
Composition/framing: orthographic straight-on flat surface; fill every pixel with the same continuous material. Uniform detail across the square and visually seamless along all four edges.
Lighting: perfectly even diffuse albedo scan with no directional lighting, no glossy highlights, no shadows, no ambient occlusion, no vignette. Engine lighting will supply shading.
Color palette: neutral very dark charcoal black enamel, modest mid-dark grey scratches and exposed steel, minimal dark muted brown corrosion; no blue cast.
Constraints: texture only, not a photograph or rendering of a forklift or panel object; no bevels, seams, borders, bolts, holes, geometry, knobs, text, decals, logos, warning labels, watermark, background, texture-map collage, baked reflections or perspective.
